newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-WASPS TAKE ENGLISH LEAGUE TITLE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WASPS TAKE ENGLISH LEAGUE TITLE.

text.p: Wasps sealed English rugby's domestic league title for the first time since 1990 by beating Northampton 26-15 in their penultimate fixture on Saturday.
Scotland wing Ken Logan scored the game's decisive try in injury time but Canadian international Gareth Rees was once again a crucial figure for the north London club, kicking 16 points.
Closest rivals Leicester, Bath and Harlequins have all invested heavily in expensive overseas talent but Wasps have emerged on top with a largely home-grown squad led by England's Lawrence Dallaglio.
"It was a collective effort," confirmed Rees afterwards. "It's a great club and we all played for each other."
